title: dispatch's OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES keeps an entry whose key holds an email address
goal: bl_dispatch.resource_entries drops an OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES entry whose key holds an email address (plain or percent-encoded), as it drops one whose value does

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "_tools"); import bl_dispatch; em = "jan" + chr(64) + "corp-mail.test"; out = bl_dispatch.resource_entries(em.replace(chr(64), "%40") + "=1", "BG-x", None); print(out); sys.exit(1 if ("%40" in out or em in out) else 0)
